(10) to prove global secular dominance f_\phi(\mu) <= f_{Neel}(\mu) and reduce the product-state supremum to the largest root of a single monic cubic P_\lambda(\mu) = 0.

Exact algebraic thermodynamics of the 4-qubit periodic ferromagnetic XX chain (Theorem C Parts 1-2): minimal polynomial H^5 - 12H^3 + 32H = 0 yields the 5-term Vandermonde Gibbs expansion (14), exact integer traces Z S_z(0) = 12 + 4a and Z S_x(\pi) = 7 + 6a - 4b + 3c - 2d, and identical e^{+2\beta} cancellation in Eq. (15).

Rigorous zero-float certification of narrow thermal PPT-bound entanglement (Theorem C Part 3): using exact rational Taylor bounds for a, b, c, d, Gershgorin operator-norm radii \delta_A, Weyl's inequality, and exact rational LDL^T Cholesky factorization of M^{T_A} - \delta_A I_{16} rigorously certifies strict positive definiteness across all 7 nontrivial bipartitions while \omega_{CMC} < 1.

High-assurance constructive formalization architecture: 20 Lean 4.35.0 theorems reported with zero sorry, zero Mathlib dependencies, and axioms strictly within [propext, Quot.sound], paired with an AST-audited rational Python verifier and adversarial forgery tests.
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact 4-qubit Bloch-vector singlet identity p_0 = (3 - S_2 + Q)/24 <= 1/3, spin-sector bound 2p_2 >= p_0, and algebraic secular-dominance identity (10) proving Neel optimality for all \lambda < 0 without SDP relaxations.

Exact Vandermonde Gibbs polynomial (14), identical e^{+2\beta} cancellation in the 3-term CMC margin (15), and zero-float rational LDL^T + Gershgorin proof of thermal PPT-bound entanglement in the N = 4 periodic XX chain.
summary: The manuscript advances the symmetric XY-chain covariance-matrix-criterion (CMC) program of Mathé, Usui, Gühne, and Vitagliano [5] on three fronts: (1) Theorem A packages Observation 1, Theorem 1, Corollary 1, and Proposition 1 of [5] into a standalone constructive Lean 4.35.0 kernel (20 theorems, zero Mathlib, zero Classical.choice); (2) Lemma 3.1 and Theorem B analytically resolve the N = 4 Neel-state product-maximization conjecture of [5] via exact Bloch-vector Casimir weights and Weinstein-Aronszajn secular dominance, reducing geometric-measure lower bounds to a cubic root without SDPs; and (3) Theorem C derives the exact algebraic thermodynamics of the N = 4 periodic ferromagnetic XX chain and certifies thermal PPT-bound entanglement at three rational inverse temperatures over Q via Taylor intervals, Gershgorin error bounds, and rational LDL^T Cholesky factorization. All core theorems and equations check out mathematically and numerically, with only a minor plotting omission in Fig. 1(b) on the left tail s_y < 0.556 and inherent N = 4 scope limitations for Theorems B and C.
weaknesses: The analytical resolution of the Neel-state optimality conjecture (Theorem B) applies only to N = 4 qubits (where J^2 has three sectors J in {0, 1, 2}); extending the technique to arbitrary even N >= 6 remains an open problem (acknowledged in Section 6).

Theorem C establishes thermal PPT-bound entanglement only for the N = 4 periodic XX chain at three discrete rational temperatures, and relies on external Lean/Python verification for the 16x16 trace moments Tr(H^m S_x(\pi)) beyond the leading orders checked manually.
Figure 1(b) omits the s_x + s_y branch for s_y < s_z - s_x = 0.556 in the plotted 'Optimal \omega_{CMC}' curve.
